book_cn: 上外版选择性必修第三册
unit_cn: Unit 2 Cherishing Friendship 珍视友谊
source: 上外版选择性必修三 Unit 2 词表(Personal Touch / The Last Leaf 真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、围绕友谊主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义;跳过专有名词(Kyle/Sue/Johnsy/Behrman 等)。

words.example_en: A true friendship can last for a whole lifetime.
words.example_cn: 真正的友谊能持续一生。

words.example_en: We should cherish the friends who stand by us.
words.example_cn: 我们应该珍视那些支持我们的朋友。

words.example_en: Kyle gave me a grateful smile after I helped him.
words.example_cn: 我帮了凯尔之后,他向我露出感激的微笑。

words.example_en: He finally got the chance to express his gratitude to his best friend.
words.example_cn: 他终于有机会向最好的朋友表达感激之情。

words.example_en: With one small gesture you can change a person's life.
words.example_cn: 一个小小的举动就能改变一个人的一生。

words.example_en: You will build some serious muscle carrying that pile of books every day.
words.example_cn: 每天搬那堆书,你会练出不少肌肉。

words.example_en: On graduation day, Kyle was chosen to give the speech.
words.example_cn: 毕业那天,凯尔被选中致辞。

words.example_en: He spoke about friendship at the graduation ceremony.
words.example_cn: 他在毕业典礼上谈到了友谊。

words.example_en: Kyle was nervous about his speech in front of the whole school.
words.example_cn: 在全校面前演讲,凯尔很紧张。

words.example_en: My friend looked nervous, so I patted him on the back.
words.example_cn: 我朋友看起来很紧张,于是我拍了拍他的背。

words.example_en: I patted him on the back and said he would be great.
words.example_cn: 我拍拍他的背,说他会表现得很棒。

words.example_en: You should thank your parents, your teachers and your siblings.
words.example_cn: 你应该感谢父母、老师和兄弟姐妹。

words.example_en: I looked at my friend in disbelief as he told the story.
words.example_cn: 他讲那个故事时,我难以置信地看着我的朋友。

words.example_en: I heard a gasp go through the crowd at his words.
words.example_cn: 听到他的话,我听见人群中一阵倒抽气声。

words.example_en: Not until that moment did I realise the depth of our friendship.
words.example_cn: 直到那一刻我才意识到我们友谊的深厚。

words.example_en: Never underestimate the power of a kind action.
words.example_cn: 永远不要低估善举的力量。

words.example_en: He was crawling around on the ground, looking for his glasses.
words.example_cn: 他在地上爬来爬去,找他的眼镜。

words.note: 作'眼泪'读 /tɪə(r)/;作'撕'读 /teə(r)/,此处取'眼泪'义
words.example_en: He tried to hold back his tears during the speech.
words.example_cn: 演讲时他努力忍住眼泪。

words.example_en: There was Kyle with a huge stack of books again.
words.example_cn: 凯尔又抱着一大摞书出现了。

words.example_en: Another boy helped him pick up the heavy pile of books.
words.example_cn: 另一个男孩帮他把那堆沉重的书捡起来。

words.example_en: Good friends help you through those tough moments.
words.example_cn: 好朋友会帮你度过那些艰难的时刻。

words.example_en: A bunch of kids ran towards the new boy and knocked his books down.
words.example_cn: 一群孩子朝那个新来的男孩跑去,把他的书撞掉了。

words.example_en: They knocked all his books out of his arms.
words.example_cn: 他们把他怀里的书全都撞掉了。

words.example_en: The older boys tripped him so that he landed in the dirt.
words.example_cn: 那几个大男孩把他绊倒,让他摔进了泥里。

words.example_en: His glasses went flying when he fell into the dirt.
words.example_cn: 他摔进泥里时,眼镜飞了出去。

words.example_en: He had planned to drop out because of loneliness at the new school.
words.example_cn: 因为在新学校的孤独,他曾打算退学。

words.example_en: He could not help recalling the wonderful weekend with his new friends.
words.example_cn: 他不禁回想起和新朋友共度的美好周末。

words.example_en: He cleared his throat and began to speak.
words.example_cn: 他清了清嗓子,开始讲话。

words.example_en: Some people always seem to stand outside, looking in at the crowd of friends.
words.example_cn: 有些人似乎总站在外面,望着那群朋友。

words.meaning_cn: (中学或大学的)新生;一年级学生
words.example_en: On that Friday, a sad freshman was carrying all his books home.
words.example_cn: 那个星期五,一个伤心的新生抱着所有的书往家走。

words.example_en: He had cleaned out his locker so that he would never come back.
words.example_cn: 他已清空了储物柜,打算再也不回来。

words.example_en: Loneliness had almost made Kyle drop out of school.
words.example_cn: 孤独差点让凯尔退学。

words.example_en: The two boys hung out together all that weekend.
words.example_cn: 那个周末两个男孩一直在一起玩。

words.example_en: That winter, pneumonia visited the village and touched Johnsy.
words.example_cn: 那年冬天,肺炎袭击了村子,琼西也被感染了。

words.example_en: Sue and Johnsy were two young painters who lived together.
words.example_cn: 苏和琼西是两个住在一起的年轻画家。

words.example_en: The last leaf on the wall was Behrman's masterpiece.
words.example_cn: 墙上那片最后的叶子是贝尔曼的杰作。

words.example_en: Johnsy watched the ivy leaves falling outside her window.
words.example_cn: 琼西望着窗外飘落的常春藤叶子。

words.example_en: She believed she would die when the last leaf fell.
words.example_cn: 她相信最后一片叶子落下时她就会死去。

words.note: 英式拼 storey,美式拼 story
words.example_en: They lived at the top of a three-storey building.
words.example_cn: 她们住在一栋三层楼房的顶层。

words.example_en: Sue went quickly to the bedside of her sick friend.
words.example_cn: 苏快步走到生病朋友的床边。

words.example_en: After the doctor left, Sue went into the workroom to cry.
words.example_cn: 医生走后,苏走进工作室哭了起来。

words.example_en: Sue had an excuse to go into the hallway as the doctor left.
words.example_cn: 医生离开时,苏借故走到走廊里。

words.example_en: They found a lantern that Behrman had taken outside in the storm.
words.example_cn: 他们发现了贝尔曼暴风雨中带到屋外的提灯。

words.example_en: Old Behrman shouted his anger over such a foolish idea.
words.example_cn: 老贝尔曼对这种愚蠢的想法怒吼起来。

words.example_en: They looked fearfully out of the window at the old tree.
words.example_cn: 他们担心地望着窗外那棵老树。

words.example_en: With good care, Johnsy slowly began to recover.
words.example_cn: 在悉心照料下,琼西慢慢开始康复。

words.example_en: The doctor said good nursing would help her win.
words.example_cn: 医生说悉心护理会帮她挺过来。

words.example_en: The illness touched many people, including Johnsy.
words.example_cn: 这场病感染了很多人,包括琼西。
